permissions.comment: Cleanup of the temporary GeoJSON the sidecar writes when a File Geodatabase layer is added (GdbSource); scoped to exactly that filename pattern so nothing else becomes deletable.

Hosts routed through the native HTTP client to bypass the WebView's CORS. Geocoding (place search / reverse geocode): public Nominatim's CDN intermittently omits the CORS header on cached responses (rejected as 'Search failed'), and the native client can send the User-Agent Nominatim's policy requires — keep the geocoder hosts in sync with the GEOCODING_PROVIDERS registry / lib/geocoding-fetch.ts. share.geolibre.app (project Share + gallery) and datasets.geolibre.app (the built-in GeoLens service) have origin-restricted CORS policies that may not include the Tauri WebView origin — see lib/share-fetch.ts and lib/geolens-fetch.ts. Any custom/self-hosted service falls back to the browser fetch.
